Nested Gaussian or binomial FPCR held-out validation

etr_nested_cross_validate_fpca_regression.Rd

Source-bounded nested Gaussian or binomial FPCA regression: train all FPCA components and scalar regression only inside the relevant folds; evaluate selected pipelines on independent outer held-out trajectories. Grouped participant-held-out folds and seeded curve-shuffle folds are implemented. With grouped CV, both the outer test set and the inner component selection use whole-participant folds, avoiding train/test participant leakage. The resulting outer prediction frame retains a group column. Select the grouped sort profile that matches the source installation. R glm.fit and Python statsmodels binomial IRLS/separation details, pandas coercion semantics, and complete Python return and exception domains remain unsupported and are not independently certified.

Usage

etr_nested_cross_validate_fpca_regression(trajectories, outcome,
  candidate_components = c(1L,2L,3L,4L,5L),
  family = "gaussian", loss = NULL, covariates = NULL,
  outer_splits = 5L, inner_splits = 4L, selection_rule = "minimum",
  scaling = "none", cv_unit = "curve", group_column = NULL,
  shuffle = FALSE, random_state = 0L,
  outer_fold_assignments = NULL, inner_fold_assignments = NULL,
  coerce_numeric_text_covariates = FALSE, random_engine = "base_R",
  group_tie_order = "native", strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return the six canonical frozen Python 1.2 scientific provenance fields and require source-compatible fold generation; shuffled curve folds must use random_engine="numpy", grouped folds an explicit NumPy tie-order profile, and R-only supplied fold assignments and numeric-text covariate coercion are rejected. The default FALSE preserves native diagnostic provenance. Runtime classes and full exceptional domains are not independently certified.

coerce_numeric_text_covariates

Native-only opt-in for finite numeric-text covariate columns, including interdigit underscores. The frozen Python source statsmodels model rejects object-typed columns, so FALSE preserves the default source-safe behavior.

trajectories

Complete native common-grid trajectories.

outcome

Finite numeric, logical or decimal numeric-looking character response per curve. Logical TRUE/FALSE becomes 1/0; binomial responses must be 0/1. R factor integer codes are not accepted.

candidate_components

Positive integer retained FPC counts.

family

"gaussian" or binary 0/1 "binomial".

loss

Gaussian: rmse (default) or mae; binomial: log_loss (default) or brier.

covariates

NULL or curve-aligned finite numeric/logical data.frame. Covariates are subset to each outer training fold, then each inner training fold, before Gaussian OLS or binomial logit fitting; held-out values are used only as fixed prediction features.

outer_splits

Outer KFold count.

inner_splits

Inner KFold count.

selection_rule

minimum or one_se.

scaling

none or dimension_sd.

cv_unit

"curve" or "group" for independent participant/cluster holdout in both outer evaluation and inner selection.

group_column

Required metadata column for grouped folds; every curve from one group remains within a single fold.

shuffle

Logical flag for shuffled curve folds. Grouped folds are deterministic.

random_state

Nonnegative integer seed for shuffled curve folds. Each inner seed is the outer seed plus the zero-based outer fold index plus one. With the NumPy engine every seed must fit in an unsigned 32-bit integer.

group_tie_order

Grouped sort profile. See etr_cross_validate_fpca_reconstruction for the native, NumPy SIMD and NumPy scalar options and supported domains. Explicit fold assignments take precedence.

random_engine

"base_R" retains the original native shuffle. "numpy" reproduces scikit-learn's seeded NumPy RandomState permutations at both levels.

outer_fold_assignments

Optional one zero-based fold ID per original trajectory; all outer folds must occur and grouped units cannot split.

inner_fold_assignments

Optional list of length outer_splits; for each outer fold, zero-based inner fold IDs align with its original-order training subset. Group leakage is rejected at both levels.

Value

Outer fold and inner selection summaries, held-out predictions and provenance.
